this grill is excellent! Very easy to use, fun, intuitive, and unlike other grills, the attachments and options available for this are never ending. Want pizza? done. Want steak? done. Want to do a rotisserie chicken? done. Smoked ribs? done.

Never looking back!!!

Results.ReviewText: I bought this 2 weeks ago. It has a good build quality and easy cleaning function. The main issue is that you cannot adjust the charcoal level. For example, if you want to grill some beef as skewers, you cannot adjust the level where the charcoal are and you cannot distribute them evenly in the kettle with the charcoal holders. And if you remove the charcoal from the holder, the gap on the charcoal tray is very wide so the charcoal will fall and you have to add more but then you won’t be able to control the heat. I would return it but unfortunately, I used it so it’s not possible. For this price, I could have bought a big charcoal grill with adjustable charcoal height level and more features.
Results.Title: Good quality but very limited

Results.ReviewText: My new Weber Master-Touch grill is really quite handy and easy to use. There are so many cool little features, compared to my old no-name grill, that I am still learning how to master the use of. This product is constructed of quality materials and with expertise. In addition to what comes in the box, there are many, many other owners (on the Internet) willing to share their cooking tips and reviews of compatible hardware.
Results.Title: Best grill I've owned

Results.ReviewText: Easy to set up IF YOU READ THE INSTRUCTIONS!  I didnt realize I got the grate with the middle that comes out, very nervous. The first time I tried to clean it the middle fell into the coals and I had to pull it out. 2nd time I knew what was up. the attachments look cool too
Results.Title: Make sure you get the grate you want but 5 stars

Results.ReviewText: Ordered direct from Weber. Custom color. Arrived in perfect condition. No paint or porcelain imperfections. Easy assembly! I've owned many used and fixer-upper kettles and this is my first new one. Weber kettles are the best all-around, backyard grills/smokers. Fun to use and producing great results!
Results.Title: Still the best!

Results.ReviewText: Easy installation and easy cleanup after grilling. The ash catcher is easy to clean after you grill and the lid mount while you’re grilling is one of the main reasons I purchased a Master Touch.
Results.Title: Makes Grilling and Cleanup Easy

Results.ReviewText: Well made, holds heat well, customer service is awesome
Results.Title: I would buy it again

Results.ReviewText: For many years I used propane because it's quicker, knowing all along that charcoal produces much better taste results.  I recently decided that, since I'm retired, I had time to use charcoal again.  I wanted a good quality grill with easy ash-removal features but didn't cost what my first car did.  After a lot of research the Master-Touch was the choice.  I couldn't be happier.  A steak done over charcoal is well worth the extra time to get the coals hot.
Results.Title: Charcoal is Better

Results.ReviewText: I had to return the Master-Touch because when it arrived, the lid was damaged. So, I had to buy an Original Kettle Premium instead because they don't carry the Master-Touch on the sales floor at Home Depot. In my opinion, the packaging is not nearly sufficient enough to allow for single item delivery. I'm sure it's just fine if it's on a pallet with a dozen other grills, but the rim of the lid rests way too close to the perimeter/edge of the box.  All it takes is one mishandled drop of the box by a delivery person, and the lid is very easily damaged.  And I am not suggesting adding Styrofoam to protect the lid; rather, the packaging should be redesigned so that the cardboard is more than sufficient. Again, I don't think this is an item that should be shipped individually. Due to the size of the box and the poor packaging, it makes for awkward handling by delivery people and could be easily dropped resulting in significant damage to the lid.
Results.Title: Poor Packaging

Results.ReviewText: I have found back the love for bbqing and also I am impressed by the amount of space on the grill despite it being 22in

Results.ReviewText: This is my 2nd Weber grill. After owning the Weber Slate 30” and now the Weber 22” Kettle. All of my future grills will be a Weber for sure. The quality of the builds are very well and the accessories that you can get with the 22” kettle are fantastic!! My wife bought me the pizza oven/rotisserie attachment is so awesome. I have used the rotisserie several times so far. This is the only way I will cook while chickens hands down. So flavorful and juicy. If you are in the hunt for a kettle grill this is the one. Totally worth it!!

This grill is simple yet has every feature you need.
It's stylish and so functional. Our old Weber has lasted about 10-12 years so when it was time to replace, of course see went for another Weber. 
So many improvments over the old model. We love it.

Results.ReviewText: I've only had my Weber master touch grill for a few weeks now but I love it. Solid, well made product. The charcoal baskets were missing when I bought it but the folks at Tourneys Ace hardware in Chesterland Oh. got me replacements next day. I've become very fond of reverse searing our steak's. Everything cooks great on this thing. I only gave it 4 stars because I have yet to smoke some ribs for the real test. From what I've read I sure it will do a great job, we'll see over the 4th of July. I also love the easy clean ash pan. I highly recommend this grill if you like cooking with charcoal and wood.
Results.Title: Quickly becoming my all time favorite grill.

Results.ReviewText:
Poor quality! My 1st Weber kettle costed $69.00. It lasted 23 years. 

I was very, very disappointed the only handle on the base came off in my hand. The handle was welded. I could have been burned very badly.   

After sending several pictures of the poor-quality kettle's handle, the 1st representative sent me the plastic cover. It has taken 5-6 weeks and I still don't have a safe kettle to use. 
plastic handle

Results.ReviewText: Great features for the classic Weber kettle. I love the built in grill top holder on the side and the easy to use ash catcher! The removable center grill rack makes lighting my charcoal so easy.
Results.Title: Love the Master Touch!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, lots of accessories. Been fun getting back to the basics.

Have always been a gas griller, but it just wasn't working any longer. So i did my research and decided to go with the webber kettle. Still learning but i am very happy with my results. The only thing to watch out for is when you are moving the kettle be careful not to lift it very high, it can tip over.
Results.Title: Used to be a gas only, now only charcoal.

Results.ReviewText: This is my first time owning and cooking on a Weber kettle grill and I will have to say that it far exceeded my expectations! I had been following different groups on social media and reading about all the things that you are able to do with it, but after I purchased one and started using it , I was amazed with it. Absolutely love it!
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText:
So, stemming back from 2011, I used my first Weber kettle at a British B&B in Dubai. I fell in love with its simplicity and controlability!

When I finished working as a contractor in the Middle East, the first thing I bought upon returning home in 2013 was my very own 22" Kettle!

Flash forward to May 2024....

I had to send the old girl to the scrap pile, as I simply wore her out.... although still serviceable, I really just needed an excuse to get my new 22" Mastertouch...lol

The engineered refinements are totally worth the money over the price of a basic kettle. Most importantly because I know I can expect at least 10 years of heavy use.

And that, is the value of Weber?
Results.Title: The Value of Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Bought my first Weber grill in 1983. This Master touch grill is the Cadillac  of charcoal grills. And clean up is easy as can be. The porcelain coating is bullet proof and easy on the eyes.
Results.Title: The Cadillac og charcoal grills

Results.ReviewText: This grill has been incredible. I got it as a gift, and was thinking I’ll upgrade to another larger grill down the road. However, after grilling with it several times and smoking some ribs on it I don’t think that will be necessary. It has great features and gets the job done. I previously only had propane grills, and the flavor that the charcoal grill gives you is a whole different taste in a good way
Results.Title: A grill that is more capable than I thought!

Results.ReviewText: Delivered quickly and was easy to assemble, and I am a 71 y.o. woman. It is pretty. Love the green color. I have not used it yet, but bought it because my son uses one and says it is great. His bbq is always yummy.

Results.Title: Wow! Ive joined a cult!

The grill cooks incredible and temperature adjustment is very easy and reliable.  Even though the frame for the wheels is so bad, I still absolutely love the grill.
Results.Title: Fabulous grill!  Horrible frame for wheels.

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber Kettle Grill...it's replaced my original Weber Kettle that was approximately 38yrs old so I can say with confidence that these grills last..
Results.Title: Can't Go Wrong

Results.ReviewText: I have that model for more than 20 years and will never change to any other
Results.Title: Weber master touch

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. Your satisfaction means a lot to us. So sorry to hear about your experience. If there is anything we can do to help please let us know. Our Care team is reaching out to follow up. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: It is a piece of crap right out the box had to have been a returned item. I have posted bad reviews about Weber on twitter and Facebook and everything I can think of
Results.Title: Like I said it’s a total piece of crap

Results.ReviewText: I am an avid BBQer and have both a Weber gas and another charcoal set up. I added the Weber Master Touch charcoal grill to my collection to have a charcoal grill which is lighter, versatile and more portable. I can easily throw it in my truck and use it at my mom and dads- I love charcoal bbqing and this allows me to use charcoal at my parents. The Weber Master Touch lights quickly and gets to temperature easily. Temperature is easy to control with the vent and damper set up and I love how the lids rests on the back of the grill. Being able to have a direct and indirect cook zone is awesome. So far I have cooked steaks and two x 10 lbs  pork butts on it. Amazing and highly recommended.
Results.Title: Reliable and easy to work with

Results.ReviewText: I really like the grill, it works great. It is the second Weber kettle grill that I own. The only thing that I don't like is the insert in the middle of the grate. When I clean the grate after cooking, it will sometimes come loose and then I have to try and reinsert it over the hot coals. I will probably have to replace the grate. The ash catcher is very well designed and works good. The blue color is eye-catching!!
Results.Title: Very Nice Grill

Results.ReviewText: Best barbequing I've done in years compared to gas grills in the past.
Results.Title: Keeping it Simple

Results.ReviewText: My first charcoal grill. I’m so glad I made this great choice. This thing does everything I asks it to. So far, I’ve hosted many parties smoked ribs and 1/3 of a brisket using another attachment. The included accessories are useful. However, I want to point out that they no longer include the baskets with the grill. Instead you get charcoal rails, which are also useful but I prefer the baskets.
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: First charcol bbq i really like it , the taste off the food it’s another experience , the features of the bbq are high quality I recommend this bbq.
Results.Title: First charcol bbq

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
